# Evolution

> An AI business operator (an AI COO) for ecommerce store owners. It handles the busywork you'd otherwise split across a VA and a stack of apps, in one accountable tool.

## What we do

Evolution runs the day-to-day operations of a Shopify/DTC store for founders doing roughly $50k to $5M a year:

- Abandoned cart and checkout recovery (email + SMS)
- Customer support and tickets (where-is-my-order, returns, replies)
- Product listings, descriptions, and SEO
- Reviews and social-proof collection
- Email/SMS lifecycle flows and retention
- Ads and creative support
- Analytics and reporting (true profit, what's actually working)

It audits the whole store, finds what's costing the owner sales, ranks the fixes by dollar impact, and handles them. One tool, one bill, accountable to the owner, for about a tenth of the cost of the usual app stack.

## Who it's for

Independent Shopify and DTC ecommerce founders, mostly in the US, doing $50k to $5M a year, who are stretched thin running everything themselves or paying a VA plus several single-purpose apps.

## How it works

Share your store, we run a free audit, find the leaks, and fix them. You pay only if it works.

## Pricing

- Free: a store audit that shows where you're losing sales, plus a limited number of operator tasks each month. No credit card required.
- Operator ($100/month): the AI COO runs the store's busywork end to end. Billed monthly, cancel anytime.
